note: Giant units that have to be long, each with a reason (specs/repository-anti-corruption §4.5; the list with every verdict is docs/system/HUGE-CLASS-MIGRATION.md). An entry records why a unit that is already giant at the merge-base has to stay long; it admits nothing: a unit that was not giant at the merge-base fails as new whether or not it is registered, and a registered unit may never grow. Keys are the unit keys of baseline.json; an entry for a unit that is no longer giant fails the gate and has to be deleted. kind: translation-table, stylesheet, static-data or generated-code. Changes here are changes to the gate.
